summary: Fresh post-integration critique finds that the universal-worker route creates real parallel value and partial deterministic compounding, but current evidence cannot establish a ~10x useful-results-per-human gain. Atomic ownership fails in recovery and recurred in portfolio fallback; global launch/idle/collision/useful-result denominators remain incomplete; the recursive Planner path still bypasses the hardened disposition ledger and stops before a replayable G2->G3 loop. The preferred candidate route keeps independent local swarms but gates mutable work by measured demand + host atomic fences and makes validated RETURN->ledger->source-builder->Planner the deterministic metabolism spine.
material_findings: 52/52 static READY normal claim paths and dynamic dependency activation show real allocator value, not proof of 52 useful completions.
10x useful durable results per human intervention remains UNPROVEN/UNMEASURABLE with current denominators.
Recovery ownership failed atomically; live portfolio fallback later persisted overlapping active claims for the same dedupe key.
G1->G2 deterministic Planner generation is materially proven, while hardened disposition ingestion/source assembly and G2->G3 execution remain incomplete.
Multi-surface integration passes only at coordination-candidate level; all public routes remain unresolved and no browser/device E2E or Served promotion is claimed.
Manual Continuity Head is a scaling tax; a separate deduplicated compiler proposal was pinned during this activation.

implement executable progress/throughput compiler plus minimal launch/idle/human-action ledgers

re-evaluate production /w only after those gates
